query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS managementAccounts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  nature ENUM('CUSTO', 'DESPESA', 'RECEITA', 'PATRIMONIAL') NOT NULL,
  costType ENUM('FIXA', 'VARIAVEL'),
  classification ENUM('OPERACIONAL', 'ADMINISTRATIVA', 'COMERCIAL', 'FINANCEIRA', 'NAO_OPERACIONAL', 'PATRIMONIAL') NOT NULL,
  impactMargin BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  impactPayroll BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  isActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  displayOrder INT DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE INDEX code_idx (code),
  INDEX name_idx (name),
  INDEX nature_idx (nature),
  INDEX classification_idx (classification)
);
